caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Original local JPEG displayed directly at full-frame review size.

motion_sampling.limitation: No animation exists in this source asset.

visual_anatomy.title: A three-way choice is announced with a large editorial headline and “VIRAL INFOGRAPHICS” in a lavender highlighted object.
visual_anatomy.layout: A three-column comparison framed as service/approach alternatives, with repeated criterion bands from top to bottom.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title → named alternatives → repeated “what they do / process / outcome / buying” bands → bottom price row.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large display title, one rough emphasis tag, strong column headers, then legible sans paragraphs and bar labels.
visual_anatomy.colour: Pink, aqua, and lavender identify each alternative from header through bottom bar.
visual_anatomy.surface: White page, fine black structural grid, rounded internal labels, pale fills, and light depth shadow.
visual_anatomy.modules: Three alternatives crossed with four repeated decision criteria plus a closing price strip.
visual_anatomy.density: High: the same question is answered for each option, so the detail is easy to compare.

motion.observed_state_change: No temporal state: this is a static JPEG source asset.
motion.motion_job: Not applicable; the complete argument must work in one frame.
motion.limitation: No animation exists in this source asset.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Choose among alternatives based on trade-offs rather than isolated claims.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Hold the evaluation criteria constant across options and reserve visual variation for the alternatives themselves.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only where the alternatives are genuinely comparable and caveats can be stated without burying the reader.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the source service categories, price claims, “viral infographic” promise, colour logic, label wording, or panel arrangement.

claim_boundary.note: The visual contains price and capability comparisons. A caption is only asserted by numeric ID and does not validate the claims.
